result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues: the category chips and a restaurant card are cut off, a restaurant name is truncated, and the promo banner text has very low contrast.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is clipped by the right screen edge, so the filter row looks incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Allow the chip row to scroll horizontally with peek/padding, or wrap/resize chips so all labels are fully visible.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol…) is cut off at the right edge and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Use a horizontal scroll with enough peek/padding, or scale cards so names and images are fully visible.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, smaller type, or ellipsis only after a complete readable name.

issues.description: Promo banner body text ('Use code TALLINN3…') is very light on a pale green background and hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text so it meets WCAG contrast against the banner background.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is cropped by the tab bar, hiding most of its details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so the last card can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: Promo headline contrast is also weak on the mint background.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green or darker type for the headline to match the rest of the UI.
